summary: Declarative seed-pack format (seed/showcase/) + importer via public REST APIs + CLI seed apply/reset, consolidating ORG_SEED/PROCESSES_SEED/migration demo-INSERTs 013-019 into one authoritative source
functional: FR-1: Pack is a schema-validated directory seed/<pack-name>/ with meta, tenant, departments, positions, employees, roles, role_assignments, grants, and optional process_instances fields
FR-2: TypeScript importer applies entities in dependency order through public REST APIs only (no direct pg access); idempotent per entity via GET-check or 409 handling
FR-3: CLI seed apply --tenant <slug> --pack <name> exits 0 on success, structured summary printed
FR-4: CLI seed reset --tenant <slug> restores tenant to pack reference state; does NOT delete genesis-owner employee (migration 026)
FR-5: showcase pack consolidates ORG_SEED (3 depts/7 positions/12 employees), PROCESSES_SEED (8 instances, display-only), RIGHTS_SEED (8 roles with grants); stable UUIDs/slugs preserved
FR-6: blank pack template seed/blank/ created for trial-tenant bootstrap
FR-7: CI gate npm run seed:smoke runs seed apply on clean DB and verifies GET /api/org and GET /api/rights return expected data
FR-8: existing e2e tests read entity IDs from pack file, not hard-coded duplicate maps
FR-NEW-1: POST /api/tenants -> 201 {id, slug} or 409 if slug exists
FR-NEW-2: POST /api/departments -> 201 {id, slug} or 409 if (tenant_id, slug) exists
FR-NEW-3: POST /api/positions -> 201 {id, slug} or 409 if (tenant_id, department_id, slug) exists
FR-NEW-4: POST /api/employees -> 201 {id, slug} or 409 if (tenant_id, slug) exists; kind in {human, agent}
FR-NEW-5: POST /api/roles -> 201 {id, slug} or 409 if (tenant_id, slug) exists
non_functional: NF-1: seed/pack.schema.json is JSON Schema draft-07, validated in CI
NF-2: importer has zero direct pg imports — all writes via HTTP (fitness check)
NF-3: seed apply on already-applied pack completes under 10 seconds on dev
NF-4: CLI error output is structured JSON to stderr, exit code non-zero on failure
NF-5: pack files contain no credentials/tokens/secrets (covered by existing CI secret-scan)
out_of_scope: Genesis-owner employee and grants (migrations/026 stays as-is)
Creating live Flowable process instances via API (PROCESSES_SEED is display-only)
Removal of in-memory ORG_SEED/PROCESSES_SEED/RIGHTS_SEED fallback constants in src/http/

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/tenants with { slug: 'showcase', display_name: '...' } returns 201 and a row exists in choros.tenant with that slug
POST /api/departments with valid body returns 201 and row in choros.department; re-POSTing same slug returns 409
POST /api/positions with valid body returns 201 and row in choros.position; re-POSTing same (department_id, slug) returns 409
POST /api/employees with kind='human' returns 201 and row in choros.employee with kind='human'; re-POST same slug returns 409
POST /api/employees with kind='agent' returns 201 and row in choros.employee with kind='agent'; re-Post same slug returns 409
POST /api/roles with valid body returns 201 and row in choros.role; re-POST same slug returns 409
seed apply --tenant showcase --pack showcase on a clean post-migration DB exits 0 and GET /api/org returns exactly 3 departments, 7 positions, 12 employees matching ORG_SEED content
Running seed apply --tenant showcase --pack showcase twice on the same DB exits 0 both times and yields identical GET /api/org responses (no duplicates)
seed reset --tenant showcase after manually inserting an extra department removes the extra department and GET /api/org returns only pack-defined departments
seed reset --tenant showcase does NOT delete the genesis-owner employee (slug='e-owner', added by migration 026)
GET /api/rights after seed apply returns exactly 8 roles matching the RIGHTS_SEED content
seed/pack.schema.json exists and validation of seed/showcase/pack.json (or equivalent) via JSON Schema validator reports zero errors
Fitness check confirms seed/*.ts importer files contain no direct 'pg' imports (grep for import.*from.*pg returns zero matches in seed/ directory)
CI secret-scan check covers seed/ directory and reports no credentials or tokens in pack files
seed apply prints a human-readable structured summary listing count of entities created and entities skipped (already existing) per type
showcase pack file contains the 8 PROCESSES_SEED process instances and GET /api/processes after seed apply returns all 8 with correct id/name/status fields
No e2e test file contains a hard-coded duplicate of employee/department/role UUID or slug that also appears in the pack file (grep-based fitness check)
seed apply uses X-Dev-User: e-owner for all privileged writes; POST /api/employees with a non-owner dev-user who lacks mgmt grants returns 403
